scientific_integrity: Analytical theorem with exact proof using a previously published complete facet description; the finite LP suite is auxiliary, not a substitute for proof. Established facet and combinatorial equivalence results are attributed.
scientific_limitations: Historical priority is provisional, particularly for equivalent submodular/polymatroid formulations; does not classify exact integer attainability of every interior ratio or all affine realizations.
title: Minkowski asymmetry fills a dense interval within one stellohedral combinatorial type
